inputs.briefingLink: #briefing=<payload>: full links from the app or briefing.createLink; b1./j1. slides-only links apply to the layers the URL loads
inputs.briefingFile: ?briefing=<https URL of a CORS-enabled .json>: a briefing document (schemas/briefing-v1.schema.json), a project containing one, or the app's briefing file
inputs.layerId: A briefing's layerId may be the layer's service URL (portable; loaded when missing), its layer ID or its title

ready.description: Promise that resolves once the view, basemap and the layers the address asked for have loaded. The same moment fires a gismap:ready window event and sets <html data-gismap-state="ready"> ("loading" and "error" otherwise).

describe.description: describe() returns these capabilities plus live state: layers, basemap, camera, skin, mode, briefing slide count, whether AI is configured, and open issues.

layers.description: Add, list, update, remove and zoom to data layers. add() resolves with LayerInfo once loaded; errors are GisMapError with a code.

camera.description: get(), set({ center, zoom | scale, heading, tilt }), fitTo(layer | "layers" | [west, south, east, north]).

application.description: Dashboard layout runtime. runTool(id, input) runs the tools listed under tools.

getProject.description: The current project as saved in a .gmo file.

events.description: The app's internal event bus; topics may change.

map.description: The ArcGIS Maps SDK Map. An escape hatch: prefer layers.*.

view.description: The ArcGIS Maps SDK SceneView (always 3D). An escape hatch: prefer camera.*.

GisMapError.description: The error class thrown by the public API: { code, message, hint, details }.

errorCodes.INVALID_URL: Pass a complete https:// URL to a service, layer or file.
errorCodes.HTTPS_REQUIRED: Use the https:// form of the URL; GIS Map Online only loads remote data over HTTPS.
errorCodes.CREDENTIAL_IN_URL: Remove the token, key or password from the URL. Only public services can be shared.
errorCodes.UNSUPPORTED_LAYER_TYPE: Use one of the layer types listed in capabilities.json (arcgis-auto, feature, map-image, imagery, geojson, wms, wfs, kml).
errorCodes.TOO_MANY_LAYERS: A map holds at most 10 data layers. Remove one with layers.remove before adding another.
errorCodes.LAYER_LOAD_FAILED: Check the URL in a browser with ?f=pjson appended. The service may be down, private or not a layer URL.
errorCodes.CORS_BLOCKED: The publisher does not allow browser access to this service. Use another source, or download the data and add it as a file.
errorCodes.SERVICE_ERROR: The service answered with an error. Check the URL, the layer number and any filter for typos.
errorCodes.FIELD_NOT_FOUND: Use a field name exactly as the service lists it; sources.inspect(url) returns the fields.
errorCodes.INVALID_SPEC: Fix the listed issues; the schema in capabilities.json describes every property.
errorCodes.NOT_FOUND: Call layers.list() to see the layers on the map and their ids.

urlParameters.layer: HTTPS layer or service URL; repeatable, index-aligned with layerType (max 10).
urlParameters.layerType: One of layerTypes, index-aligned with layer.
urlParameters.basemap: One of basemaps. Applied before the scene starts.
urlParameters.zoom: "layers" (default when no camera is given) fits the loaded data; "none" keeps the starting view.
urlParameters.center: lon,lat in degrees; with scale= or level=.
urlParameters.view: Not supported: the scene is always 3D.

tools.description: Add a public layer by HTTPS URL (ArcGIS REST, GeoJSON, WMS, WFS or KML) and wait until it has loaded.

url.description: HTTPS URL of a layer, service or GeoJSON file.

where.description: A read-only SQL where clause on the layer's fields, such as "POP > 1000". null clears it.

renderer.description: A RendererSpec, such as { "type": "choropleth", "field": "POP", "ramp": "greens" }. See schemas/renderer-v1.schema.json.

ignoreServiceScaleRange.description: Draw at every zoom level, ignoring the publisher's scale range.

zoomTo.description: Fit the view to the data; default true for the first data layer.

tools.description: Remove a layer from the map.

layer.description: The layer's id (from layers.list()), service URL or title.
